organization.fullName: Alliance for Clinical Trials in Oncology

identificationModule.briefTitle: Dexamethasone in Reducing Everolimus-Induced Oral Stomatitis in Patients With Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase III Placebo-Controlled Trial to Evaluate Dexamethasone Use for Everolimus-Induced Oral Stomatitis: Prevention Versus Early Treatment Approaches: MIST (My Individualized Stomatitis Treatment)

armGroups.label: Group I (dexamethasone)
armGroups.description: Patients receive 10mg oral everolimus daily as standard of care and 10ml dexamethasone oral mouthwash, swished for 2-minutes daily, for 8 weeks.

armGroups.label: Group II (placebo)
armGroups.description: Patients receive 10mg oral everolimus daily as standard of care and 10ml placebo oral mouthwash, swished for 2-minutes daily, for 8 weeks.
